title: fix(app-shell,console): greet a signed-out invitee for the invitation and name the inviter on the accept page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9LKeba71YpzyhE5BBj3VziL)_

Part of #25886

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The UI half of the card: the parts that need no new server read.

- **Login page, signed out from an invitation link.** `/login?redirect=/accept-invitation/ID` used to show the returning-user card, 「欢迎回来 / 登录后继续你的工作」, with a small "Sign up" link under the form. Both login pages, the console's own (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`, the page `/_console/login` actually mounts) and `DefaultLoginPage` in app-shell, now title the card "Accept your invitation · Use the email address the invitation was sent to." (zh: 「接受邀请 · 请使用收到邀请的邮箱。」). Where the server offers sign-up to this visitor (`decideSignUpOffer` answers `form`), a full-width "Create an account and join" link (「注册并加入」) sits above the sign-in form, with a divider "or sign in to an existing account", in place of the small link. The one implementation is the new app-shell export `InvitationSignUpPrompt`. With `disableSignUp: true` the invitee gets the invitation header and the sign-in form only.
- **Register page from an invitation redirect.** Both register pages title the form "Create an account to join" and ask for the address the invitation was sent to, because only that account can accept it.
- **Accept page.** `DefaultAcceptInvitationPage` shows an "Invited by" row with `inviterEmail`, which better-auth's `GET /organization/get-invitation` already returns. That route returns no inviter name, so the row shows the address. No row is drawn when the answer has none.
- Seven new keys in all ten locale packs (`auth.login.invitation*`, `auth.register.invitation*`, `organization.accept.invitedBy`), and the `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` registry hash re-recorded.

## Left for a server card (not in this PR)

The signed-out page still names no organization, inviter or invited address, and the email is not prefilled. There is no signed-out read of an invitation today. better-auth 1.7.12 (the version plugin-auth pins) answers `get-invitation` with `401 Not authenticated` when there is no session. With a session it also requires the signed-in email to equal the invited address, and may require it to be verified. `auth-route-ledger.ts` lists no anonymous invitation route. A preview needs a plugin-auth read that returns only the organization display name, the inviter display name and the invited address, only for a pending, unexpired invitation. That is the seat's to file. The "skip the second verification mail" item on the card is the same server-side kind. #25886 remains open for both.

## Tests

At `baa3ba94` (after merging `origin/main` c16c00f9):

- `pnpm exec vitest run` (from `ui/`, under the verify lock) over `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/`, `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/`, `apps/console/src/pages/auth/`, `packages/i18n/` and the product-neutral ratchet: **Test Files 133 passed (133), Tests 1691 passed, 13 skipped**. This run was before the merge commit. The merge brought no change to these files.
- New pins: `acceptInvitationInviter-25886.test.tsx` (inviter row in en and zh, no row without an address). Updated pins in `signUpFollowsPosture-11691.test.tsx` (console) and `defaultPagesFollowPosture-11705.test.tsx` (app-shell): an invitation redirect gets the invitation heading, the prompt link to `/register?redirect=…` and no small "Sign up" link; with sign-up off, the heading and no prompt; the register form carries the invitation title.
- Ablation: with the console `LoginPage.tsx` and `AcceptInvitationPage.tsx` restored to the base `a3e5bfa6` (marker counts 0 and 0), **5 of 14 tests failed**: the three invitation cases in the console suite and two of the inviter cases. The third inviter case, "no row", passes on both trees, as expected. After restoring with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/console --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` after building the `@object-ui/console^...` closure: exit 0, no TS errors.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 46 commands. All 46 ran locally with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciled 46 of 46. `check:query-options-erasure` and `check:type-check-debt` hit a 300 s per-command cap on the shared box on the first pass and passed on a re-run without the cap. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` passed after the re-record.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's comment about the environment-host login (a member's first visit greeted with 「欢迎回来」, no invitation redirect involved) is not covered. Telling a first visit from a return without an invitation signal is a separate design question. Not filed.
- `InvitationSignUpPrompt` is a new public export of `@object-ui/app-shell`, so the changeset is `patch` on app-shell, console and i18n.
